milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the yellow stained glass pillar and face it to demonstrate they have visually located it. Target is the center of the pillar at spawn-relative (5, 1, 5), with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining dead horn coral block with any pickaxe drops the block itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts without this item, so having 1 in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the brown stained glass pane structure and face it. Target is the center of the structure at spawn-relative (-5, 1, -4), with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because mining light gray stained glass pane with the provided Silk Touch pickaxe drops the pane itself as an item into inventory. Without Silk Touch glass panes drop nothing, but the scene provides a Silk Touch iron pickaxe specifically for this purpose.
